title: A Summer for the Postcard
author: Sable Amberdale
blurb: Rosalind Pemberton, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
